description: Trash business logic fix: prevent featuring trashed posts in backend, hide Featured toggle in admin Trash tab
steps: In backend/src/modules/admin/admin.service.js, in the addFeaturedPost function, change `const postExists = await Post.exists({ _id: postId });` to `const postExists = await Post.exists({ _id: postId, deletedAt: null });`

In admin/src/pages/Posts.tsx, find the Featured column's <td> cell that renders the star button. Wrap the Featured toggle button in a conditional: only render it when activeTab === 'active'. When activeTab === 'trash', render nothing (or a dash) in that cell.
acceptance_criteria: Backend addFeaturedPost query includes { deletedAt: null } condition
Admin Posts page shows Featured toggle only on the Active tab, not on the Trash tab
verification: Read backend/src/modules/admin/admin.service.js and confirm the addFeaturedPost function uses { _id: postId, deletedAt: null }
Read admin/src/pages/Posts.tsx and confirm Featured toggle is conditionally hidden for trash tab
findings: Both changes applied cleanly. Backend addFeaturedPost now includes deletedAt: null check. Admin Posts.tsx Featured toggle conditionally renders only when activeTab === 'active'. Cannot run build/test due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode but changes are minimal and syntactically correct.
